role.name: DVA-Client
role.description: Pick this if you call a GUPZ data platform, as a DVA does, and want to know whether the token you produce is right. Your system calls Conformancelab, which reads what it can of the token that arrives: that it is there, that it is encrypted and not merely signed, and that its header declares what the specification prescribes. Send the token you would send to a real platform.
